selector.rationale: The patient developed transient cardiogenic shock and had a cystic mass above the left atrium, which is consistent with cardiac tamponade. The elevated cardiac troponin I level and diffuse hypokinesis of the left ventricle also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: No specific evidence to support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Cardiac Lymphoma
rejected.why: No definitive evidence of lymphoma, such as lymphadenopathy or specific tumor markers

rejected.label: Cardiac Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: No granulomatous inflammation or other characteristic features of sarcoidosis mentioned

rejected.label: Cardiac Metastasis
rejected.why: No primary cancer mentioned, and the mass characteristics are not typical of metastasis
